name: Californias Taco Shop
notes: No first-party website in batch. Restaurant's listed domain californiastacoshop.shop 301-redirects to californias-taco-shop.foodyvo.com -- a farm-pattern cheap-TLD redirect per playbook rule, not used. Confirmed correct branch via address match (15817 Bernardo Center Dr Ste104, San Diego) in the DoorDash page (there are other same-name locations in the chain, e.g. E H St and Clairemont). Read the standalone @type:Menu JSON-LD block (page-service.doordash.com mirror, since www.doordash.com 403'd) via hasMenuSection->hasMenuItem->offers.price; deduped on name+price (80 unique rows, no exact duplicates found). Count of 80 is near the known 79/91 DoorDash truncation zone, so cross-checked: greps for Breakfast/Drinks/Kids/Sides elsewhere in the page all resolved to generic DoorDash site-wide SEO/UI strings, not store-specific category names, so no evidence of a missing section for this store.

name: Adelaide Restaurant
notes: Restaurant's own site (laubergedelmar.com/dining/adelaide) renders its menu client-side with no prices in static HTML. Used third-party SinglePlatform listing instead; address on that page verified exact match to batch (1540 Camino Del Mar, Del Mar) via embedded JSON-LD/footer address and phone. The page bundles several L'Auberge Del Mar outlets (Kid's Menu, Pool Bar, Living Room Bar, In-Room Dining) under one listing; only the Adelaide-identified Breakfast/Brunch/Lunch and Dinner sections were extracted, skipping the separate Pool Bar / Living Room Bar / Kid's Menu / In-Room Dining sections since those are different outlets not represented by this restaurantId. Dinner entree prices ($18-$95) are consistent with independent press coverage of Adelaide as a fine-dining restaurant, confirming this is not a wrong-venue mixup.
